description: SIDE EFFECT, MAY SPEND MONEY: buys one paid chapter of a Mike Fluff Press book, on its own, for whoever the token speaks for (OAuth scope "mikefluff:purchase"; without a token, HTTP 401 and the client signs the person in). The chapter is then theirs to read on the site and whole through get_chapter_preview. Paid the same ways as buy_book: from the person's INITE wallet where they allowed this shop, else one link for them (wallet or card/PIX); an agent signed in as itself pays the returned x402Url from its own INITE wallet (pay tool at billing.inite.ai/mcp/wallet). Owning the book already includes every chapter. Get chapter ids from list_books. Only call when the user has asked to buy this chapter.

email.description: Optional: the user's email, for the receipt when the account has none.

locale.description: Language of the chapter and currency of the price.

name: buy_chapter
title: Buy one chapter
